info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Connect Generate Transfer Bill Pay Switch-v5-spec
info.description: The Bill Pay Switch Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage bill payment transfers seamlessly. This endpoint allows users to generate and connect to payment switches, facilitating efficient financial transactions. Typically utilized by financial institutions or payment service providers, this API streamlines the process of integrating and executing bill payment solutions. With this functionality, developers can enhance their applications to offer reliable and swift payment experiences for end-users.

post.summary: Initiate a bill payment switch transfer.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a transfer for switching bill payments. It facilitates the seamless transition of bill payment responsibilities from one party to another.
